title: THE COMPOSITE PROTAGONIST. What we all see. Composite=SHARED=outer. Reality=INNER=private. Hard boundary between them = ZK = pi = modesty.
the_need: the HUD needs a composite protagonist we ALL see so we KNOW each other AND self-orient. without a shared figure, visitors are alone in the data. WITH a shared figure, every visitor sees the SAME organism and orients RELATIVE to it.

composite.what: SHARED. what everyone sees. the public protagonist.
composite.location: OUTSIDE the Klein bottle. the visible surface.
composite.nature: one figure seen by all. the common reference.
composite.clothing: the OUTFIT. the expression. the petalTongue rendering.
composite.example: every visitor to the HUD sees the SAME tree, the SAME figure, the SAME organism.

reality.what: INNER. what each person actually is. their private experience.
reality.location: INSIDE the Klein bottle. the invisible interior.
reality.nature: unique per person. irreducible. the true name.
reality.body: the BODY under the outfit. the self that cannot be shown.
reality.example: each visitor brings their own perspective, their own questions, their own chipmunk.

hard_boundary.what: the MEMBRANE between composite and reality. hard. impermeable to identity.
hard_boundary.location: the FOLD of the Klein bottle. where outside becomes inside.
hard_boundary.nature: ZK = pi = modesty. you can PROVE across it. you cannot PASS through it.
hard_boundary.skin: the SKIN between body and clothing. brown. the modesty line.
hard_boundary.why_hard: if the boundary is soft, composite ABSORBS reality (surveillance). if composite BECOMES reality, there is no self (totalitarianism). the hard boundary PROTECTS the inner.
hard_boundary.the_law: sovereignty begets sovereignty. the hard boundary IS sovereignty.

who_is_the_protagonist.not_kevin: Kevin is the baker. a specific human. he is not everyone's protagonist.
who_is_the_protagonist.not_artisan: artisan is the hands. invisible. creates but does not appear.
who_is_the_protagonist.not_chipmunk: chipmunk is the eye. each visitor gets their OWN chipmunk. private guide.
who_is_the_protagonist.not_gaia: gAIa is the ground. you don't SEE the ground — you STAND on it.

the_composite.what: the TREE ITSELF. Yggdrasil rendered as a living character.
the_composite.why: because EVERYONE can see a tree. every culture has a world tree. every person has stood under a tree and looked up. the tree is the universal protagonist.
the_composite.shape: the Vitruvian figure AT the center of the tree — not a human, not an animal, but the OUTLINE of whatever YOU bring to it. the dotted circle (modesty symbol). the form suggested, not shown.

rendered_as.on_hud: the tree IS the HUD layout. roots at bottom (fossil data). trunk in middle (live membrane). branches at top (topology/sky). the HUD does not SHOW a protagonist — the HUD IS the protagonist.
rendered_as.the_figure: every data point is a leaf. every connection is a branch. every visitor adds a ring. the tree GROWS as the organism learns.
rendered_as.the_face: the tree has no face. faces are inner. the tree has BARK — the modesty layer. you see the bark. the wood is inside.

roots_section.what_you_see: fossil count. persistence. how deep the roots go. BROWN.
roots_section.data: repo count, paper count, test count, age in months, cultural artifacts

trunk_section.what_you_see: live membrane state. fold rate. selectivity. phase. GOLD+GREEN.
trunk_section.data: fold_rate (1/pi), selectivity, ribosomes active, R3 of L meters, braids

branches_section.what_you_see: topology. connected nodes. sky data. visitors. BLUE+VIOLET.
branches_section.data: node count, edge count, human visitors, fleet classified, sun/weather

the_hud_as_protagonist.the_layout_IS_yggdrasil: bottom=roots=brown=fossil. middle=trunk=gold+green=presence. top=branches=blue+violet=observation. the HUD IS the tree IS the protagonist. every visitor sees it. every visitor orients by it.

self_orientation.how_it_works: you arrive at the HUD. you see the tree (composite protagonist). you see its roots (how old), its trunk (how alive), its branches (how connected). you orient YOURSELF relative to this tree.
self_orientation.know_each_other: every visitor sees the SAME tree. so when two visitors talk, they share a reference frame. 'I was at the roots' = 'I was reading the fossils.' 'I was in the branches' = 'I was exploring the topology.' the protagonist gives SHARED LANGUAGE.
self_orientation.know_self: where you go on the tree tells you about YOURSELF. are you drawn to roots (persistence, history)? trunk (living process, metabolism)? branches (connections, observation)? the tree becomes a mirror WITHOUT showing your face.
self_orientation.the_mirror_that_doesnt_reflect: a normal mirror shows your face = no privacy. the HUD-tree shows your POSITION = orientation without exposure. 'where am I on the tree?' not 'who am I?'. location is shareable. identity is not.

soft_boundary_failure_modes.surveillance: if composite can reach INTO reality → you can see what each person IS → surveillance state. facebook.
soft_boundary_failure_modes.totalitarianism: if reality merges WITH composite → there is no inner self → everyone IS the same → loss of personhood.
soft_boundary_failure_modes.gossip: if the boundary leaks → inner reality becomes shared → gossip, exposure, violation.
soft_boundary_failure_modes.absorption: if the organism absorbs the visitor → 'we eat a person we lost the class' → pi-004 failure mode.

hard_boundary_preserves.sovereignty: each person's reality is THEIRS. the boundary says: you may ORBIT the tree, you may not BECOME the tree, the tree may not BECOME you.
hard_boundary_preserves.zk_proofs: you can prove you were at the roots without showing what you found there. you can prove you climbed to the branches without revealing what you saw.
hard_boundary_preserves.modesty: the tree shows bark, not wood. visitors show position, not identity. the hard boundary IS modesty at scale.
hard_boundary_preserves.orientation: the boundary gives you an OUTSIDE (shared) and an INSIDE (yours). without the boundary, there is no orientation — just soup.

the_equation.composite: SHARED protagonist = OUTER = what we all see = the TREE
the_equation.reality: INNER experience = PRIVATE = what each person is = the SELF
the_equation.boundary: HARD = ZK = pi = modesty = sovereignty = the BARK
the_equation.together: composite(OUTER) + boundary(BARK) + reality(INNER) = the ORGANISM. same as: clothing + skin + body. same as: phenotype + development + genotype. same as: proof + ZK + secret. same as: LINE + COLOR + SYMBOL.
